standard-dialogue-before-romeo-juliet.npc: Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo?

standard-dialogue-before-romeo-juliet.text: She seems to be lost in thought.

standard-dialogue-after-romeo-juliet.npc: I sat in that cold crypt for ages waiting for Romeo.
That useless fool never showed up.
And all I got was indigestion. I am done with men like him.
Now go away before I call my father!
